title: Nourishing Jamaican Peaches Stew
description: A tangy, dense stew that blends sweet peaches, coconut milk, and Jamaican curry for a comforting sick‑day meal.
instructions: Peel, pit, and dice the peaches and set them aside.
Heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic, and sauté until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the curry powder and allspice, cooking for 30 seconds to release their aromas.
Pour in the coconut milk and water, then add the diced peaches and stir to combine.
Season with salt, honey, lemon juice, and crushed red pepper flakes, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the stew cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the peaches soften and the flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional honey or lemon juice if needed.
Remove from heat and stir in the chopped cilantro.
Serve hot, spooning the thick stew into bowls and garnishing with extra cilantro if desired.
